shots.text: It started as a hum. Low, in the back of my head, every time the green pulsed.
shots.note: Close on Lord Mandros; the veins pulse with the hum.

shots.text: Then one night, alone on the throne, the hum turned into words.
[I gave you everything. Your speed. Your senses. Your crown.]
[The same thing you want. To never be weak again.]
I should've been scared. Instead, I felt understood for the first time in my life.
Every ant who ever ignored me, every ant who threw me into the waste chamber, the voice remembered them too.
[They will always fear what you are. Let them.]
I didn't sleep that night. I didn't need to. The voice kept me company until morning.
